title: The Three Icons of the Righteous and the First Man's Prayer
description: T99 expounds the three forms in the righteous soul: the spiritual form (the New Man, where the Lord ordering the inner mind fashions himself a dwelling and abides); the psychic form (residue and remainder, where the soul lies mingled with bitterness, desire, foolishness, envy, discord, false teachings); the bodily form (outermost, into which the soul sinks when it descends to be fed). Daily the Living Soul passes through these three, laying off body, laying off mingled affections, and conjoining itself spiritually with patience, faith, and love that is queen — the pure receivability who is robe to the New Man, called the hour of life, first and last. T100 narrates the cry from affliction and the help the Father sends: the prayer of the life-bearing principle for the divine humanity bound in the proprium's reign; the Father's threefold sending of operative power, which raises and gives expanse; the building of structure; the five at the consummation interceding for the living soul who still remains in purification.
